meta.north_note: front (+y) faces East, so North is +x (right on the plan)
meta.rot_convention: furniture rot in degrees; local +y is the front of the piece; rot=0 faces +y (front), 90 faces -x, 180 faces -y (lawn), 270 faces +x
meta.wall_convention: walls are centrelines a->b (or arc) with thickness t; openings at `offset` mm along the wall from a; hinge a|b; swing = world direction the leaf opens into
